composition.description: Tokens concatenate left to right. Typical unit: speech-act, role, zero or more actions, targets, constraints, then macros.

compact.when: both peers advertise VQX, versions compatible, dictionary SHA-256 agrees, required security capabilities agree, and VQX is useful

local_macros.scope: session and peer; never persist across unrelated peers
local_macros.stateless: include LOCAL_TABLE_HASH or equivalent in envelope metadata

authorization: Decoding EXECUTE or INSTALL does not grant permission. Authorization is a runtime policy layer.
